name: Acme Invoicing
description: Invoice creation, management, and payment collection application.

pages.title: Login
pages.description: Authenticate with email and password. Fields: email, password. Actions: login-submit.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: Overview of recent activity. Actions: nav-create-invoice, nav-invoices, nav-clients.

pages.title: Invoices
pages.description: View, filter, search, and manage all invoices. Actions: create-invoice-button, invoice-filter-status.

pages.title: Create Invoice
pages.description: Create a new invoice. Required fields: field-client-name, field-amount, field-due-date. Actions: invoice-form-submit, invoice-form-cancel.

pages.title: Invoice Detail
pages.description: View, edit, send, or delete a single invoice. Actions: invoice-edit, invoice-send, invoice-delete.

pages.title: Edit Invoice
pages.description: Edit an existing invoice. Required fields: field-client-name, field-amount, field-due-date. Actions: invoice-edit-save, invoice-edit-cancel.

pages.title: Clients
pages.description: View and manage clients. Actions: create-client-button.

workflows.title: Create and send an invoice
workflows.description: Creates a new invoice, sets required fields, submits it, and sends it to the client.

steps.description: Fill in invoice details (client name, amount, due date) and submit.
Confirm the invoice was created. Click 'Send Invoice' to send.

workflows.title: Edit an existing invoice
workflows.description: Navigates to an invoice, opens edit mode, makes changes, and saves.

steps.description: Find the target invoice in the list.

authentication.description: Session cookie-based authentication. Navigate to /login, fill in email and password, and submit. All other pages redirect to /login if unauthenticated.

agentNotes: The application uses a single-page architecture. URL changes are reflected in the browser history but the page does not fully reload. Wait for data-agent-state transitions to 'idle' or 'success' before assuming an action completed.
